recorded.pass:q-discount-next-line:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-discount-next-line:c: Directly refuted: 'the order you measure belongs to the machine you measured on', with the one-core run giving the other order about one run in seven.
recorded.prompt:q-discount-next-line:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-discount-next-line:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-discount-next-line:d: Held by inference: the page says 'the scheduler decides when the new thread gets a CPU' and shows the worker going first in some runs, so the thread can run before the caller returns; it never says this in so many words.

recorded.prompt:q-cli-virtual-upload:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cli-virtual-upload:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cli-virtual-upload:c: Directly refuted by the same callout and the output 'virtual daemon: true' with no report written.
recorded.prompt:q-loaded-flag:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-loaded-flag:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-loaded-flag:b: Held by inference: the page shows the write happened (main sees done = true) and blames the missing rule, never stating that a reader's loop does not block the writer.
recorded.prompt:q-loaded-flag:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-loaded-flag:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-loaded-flag:c: Held by inference: the page never mentions atomicity; the reader must infer that a boolean write being atomic does not help from 'No rule connects the worker's write ... to the reader's reads' and the observed result.
recorded.prompt:q-loaded-flag:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-loaded-flag:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-loaded-flag:d: Refuted by the example: the worker finished yet the reader was 'still waiting 2 s later: true', and the page names join() and isAlive() returning false as the hand-overs.

recorded.outcome:q-shutdown-remaining-ms:c: Directly refuted: join(300) 'returned the way it returns when the thread ends: no exception, no value'; only a negative remaining time throws IllegalArgumentException.
recorded.prompt:q-shutdown-remaining-ms:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shutdown-remaining-ms:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-shutdown-remaining-ms:d: Refuted by example: join(300) on a sleeping, uninterrupted thread returned after 300 ms; the page never mentions interruption as the reason, so the reader links them by inference from that output.
